scope: 649 catalog template variants (648 active, one deprecated); excludes content-complete reusable slides and frame/rail Cartesian expansion
method: Purpose/AST inventory for every variant; renderer/CLI source review for priority composition types. No new rendering or desktop qualification in this audit. Profile mappings are review assignments, not proof of supported commands.

family_review.name: Covers and section dividers
family_review.summary: Covers, agendas, section dividers and closings: the slides that open and structure a deck.

family_review.name: Our understanding
family_review.summary: How a proposal restates what the client asked for: a single statement, situation to ask, quoted requirements, objectives and measures, scope and assumptions, drivers around the ask, RFP traceability, a dense one-page restatement and a two-slide context and scope pair.

family_review.name: Core content
family_review.summary: Key messages, card rows, narrative and quotes: the everyday content slides.

family_review.name: Argument and frameworks
family_review.summary: Pillars, comparisons, from-to shifts, problem framing and capability frameworks that carry the storyline.

family_review.name: Evidence and data
family_review.summary: Stats, charts, 2x2s, status and image-led evidence.

family_review.name: Funnels and pyramids
family_review.summary: Funnels and pyramids: stages that narrow and levels that build on each other. Roadmaps and timelines moved to the Roadmaps family on 2026-10-06.

family_review.name: Heat maps
family_review.summary: Shaded matrices that show where to look: capability and application portfolios, risk grids, capacity by week, heat-tile maps, readiness and survey results.

family_review.name: Status, steering and RAID
family_review.summary: Status reports, steering updates, RAID logs, milestones by workstream and four-panel dashboards.

family_review.name: Venn diagrams
family_review.summary: Two-, three- and four-circle Venn diagrams with set text, labelled overlaps and plotted points, in every frame.

family_review.name: Architecture
family_review.summary: Layer stacks, nested and reference architectures, application ecosystems and cloud landing zones.

family_review.name: Solution and architecture
family_review.summary: Solution views: process flows, workstreams, readiness, pathways and context models.

family_review.name: Product lifecycle (PDLC and SDLC)
family_review.summary: The product development lifecycle (Identify, Define, Build, Optimize) and the software development lifecycle inside it (Design, Build, Test, Verify, Release), drawn as cycles with loop-backs rather than chevrons: overview, how the SDLC maps into the PDLC, phase detail, sub-phases, roles and health.

family_review.name: Software product delivery
family_review.summary: Capability maps, now/next/later roadmaps and product development lifecycle (PDLC) slides for a software product build and enhancement offering, with the SDLC drawn as an overlay.

family_review.name: Modernization lifecycle
family_review.summary: The Rationalize, Build and Sustain lifecycle: overview, capability maps, scope maps, activity charts and the Intellio asset map.

family_review.name: Maturity curves
family_review.summary: Maturity curves that stay flat and then rise steeply, with numbered stages, an active stage, an inflection and an optional branch: generic four- and five-stage models in full-width, split, nav and table forms, and the AI-native product delivery curve with its capabilities, two-axis, stage-detail, assessment and coaching-plan companions.

family_review.name: Decision records
family_review.summary: Architecture decision records, options considered, decision paths, logs, superseded decisions and decision requests.

family_review.name: Approach and plan
family_review.summary: Phases, phase detail, gates, roadmaps, work plans and cutover.

family_review.name: Roadmaps
family_review.summary: Roadmaps and timelines: graphic roads (straight and branching), now/next/later, roadmap structures and dense grids, narrative roadmaps, phased plans and milestone timelines. Collected from the diagrams, software and approach families on 2026-10-06.

family_review.name: Team curves
family_review.summary: Team ramp curves by phase: client and partner teams, agents taking on run work, with phase titles and text in the curves.

family_review.name: Stakeholder interviews
family_review.summary: Who we met, when, what we learned and what we still need: readout tables, interview summaries and per-person detail, planned waves, coverage for long engagements, access difficulties and the follow-up request tracker.

family_review.name: Workshops
family_review.summary: One-page workshop overviews and invites, series plans, after-workshop readouts and facilitator run-of-show plans for the Patient access future-state workshop series.

family_review.name: Runbooks
family_review.summary: Runbook overview, roles, escalation, step lists, step details and go/no-go checklists.

family_review.name: Change management and communications
family_review.summary: Change impact, stakeholder maps, communications plans, readiness, training, adoption tracking and the change network for a platform rollout.

family_review.name: Commercials
family_review.summary: Pricing by option, milestone and capacity run-rate, and optional scope.

family_review.name: One-page proposals
family_review.summary: Packaged offerings on one dense page: approach, deliverables, price, value, a mini Gantt or team, a proof or sample asset, and a few assumptions.

family_review.name: Investment and value
family_review.summary: Value created against the investment: the headline comparison, the bridge from spend to net value, break-even curves, value levers, scenarios, phases, hard and soft value, the cost of inaction, realization tracking and where the money goes against where the value comes from.

family_review.name: Team and governance
family_review.summary: Org charts, pods, rosters, bios, roles by phase and governance.

family_review.name: About West Monroe
family_review.summary: Firm overview, locations, industries, alliances and how we work with clients.

family_review.name: Proof and reference
family_review.summary: Case studies, client proof, history, sample deliverables and appendix references.
